title: Alfies 1st Session

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Hey! I set up your client file. You're cleared for therapy. You ready to start?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! I set up your client file. You're cleared for therapy. You ready to start?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Sure! What do you want, an office with a plant and a comfortable chair? A lamp? Ha!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure! What do you want, an office with a plant and a comfortable chair? A lamp? Ha!

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Nothing! It's in everyone's interest to keep citizens engaged in the workforce, not feeling emotions or thinking about trauma.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing! It's in everyone's interest to keep citizens engaged in the workforce, not feeling emotions or thinking about trauma.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: What issues should we talk about? Career, romance or general ennui?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What issues should we talk about? Career, romance or general ennui?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Ok, I got you. With career issues, there's just one thing you have to focus on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, I got you. With career issues, there's just one thing you have to focus on.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: The key to finding love is no secret. There's one technique everyone overlooks when it comes to finding a partner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The key to finding love is no secret. There's one technique everyone overlooks when it comes to finding a partner.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Oh don't worry about that. Just ignore it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh don't worry about that. Just ignore it.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Well, I guess you've progressed to the next level of the Sanguine Minds project. How do you feel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I guess you've progressed to the next level of the Sanguine Minds project. How do you feel?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Your true goal. When you feel dissatisfied, listless and directionless at work, just remember where your true value lies. Every morning when you wake, and every night when you sleep, remember what is the most important aspect of your employment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your true goal. When you feel dissatisfied, listless and directionless at work, just remember where your true value lies. Every morning when you wake, and every night when you sleep, remember what is the most important aspect of your employment.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: No. God no! Stakeholder value. That's all that matters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. God no! Stakeholder value. That's all that matters.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: What, you think your career is about YOU? Stop being so selfish. Lots of people rely on you. If you feel like things are unfair... push those feelings down. You owe it to the people who own shares in your employer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What, you think your career is about YOU? Stop being so selfish. Lots of people rely on you. If you feel like things are unfair... push those feelings down. You owe it to the people who own shares in your employer.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: No, none of those. A willingness to settle for less. Everyone can find a compatible partner if they don't overreach. And couples are proven to spend more than single people, contributing to the flow of commerce.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, none of those. A willingness to settle for less. Everyone can find a compatible partner if they don't overreach. And couples are proven to spend more than single people, contributing to the flow of commerce.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: When one partner is noticeably more successful, attractive and charismatic than the other. The low value partner spends more to impress their superior. The high value partner spends more to alleviate their dissatisfaction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When one partner is noticeably more successful, attractive and charismatic than the other. The low value partner spends more to impress their superior. The high value partner spends more to alleviate their dissatisfaction.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: If possible, but we also have to be realistic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If possible, but we also have to be realistic.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Look, I'm no romance expert. As you can see. But... you want my advice? Don't let go of anything you manage to catch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'm no romance expert. As you can see. But... you want my advice? Don't let go of anything you manage to catch.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Sure. And the malaise, and the melancholia. All of that. You don't need to worry about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. And the malaise, and the melancholia. All of that. You don't need to worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Of course! Why would you worry about it? It's just everything. And you can't change everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! Why would you worry about it? It's just everything. And you can't change everything.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Stick with it. Every session we have will help you ball your rage and sadness in a ball at the pit of your stomach tighter and tighter... till it just disappears!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stick with it. Every session we have will help you ball your rage and sadness in a ball at the pit of your stomach tighter and tighter... till it just disappears!

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Uh, most people don't ask me how I'm doing. In fact, most people don't even stop to talk to me. Though I prefer that to the ones that spit in my face.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh, most people don't ask me how I'm doing. In fact, most people don't even stop to talk to me. Though I prefer that to the ones that spit in my face.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Yeah. I don't know how much longer I can take this. I'm clinging on here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. I don't know how much longer I can take this. I'm clinging on here.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I can't quit. I... Fuck, I can't say. I'll see you around, k?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't quit. I... Fuck, I can't say. I'll see you around, k?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: No need to thank me! Helping others avoid their trauma and control their emotions is its own reward. Our session is now over, but we'll talk again soon!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No need to thank me! Helping others avoid their trauma and control their emotions is its own reward. Our session is now over, but we'll talk again soon!
